trap-nonspeakable.notes: NOT A STYLE FIX - MATH/NOTATION FINDING, reported not applied. The block writes the Hecke generator as T_{s_i} and its quadratic relation as (T_{s_i} - q)(T_{s_i} + 1) = 0. AGENTS.md SS7a is STRICT on both points: the generator is sigma_i, NEVER T, and the relation is (sigma_i - q)(sigma_i + q^{-1}) = 0, equivalently sigma_i^2 = (q - q^{-1}) sigma_i + 1. The form printed here is the OTHER standard normalisation (eigenvalues q and -1 rather than q and -q^{-1}); it is not wrong mathematics but it is a different normalisation from the repo's, and mixing the two silently changes the Markov-trace and skein normalisations downstream. Note the sibling thm:groebner-shirshov-energy in this same chapter uses the SS7a form sigma_i^2 = (q - q^{-1}) sigma_i + 1, so the two blocks currently disagree. The .ts lean ref (QOU.IwahoriHecke.Tw....) suggests the T_w spelling is entrenched, so this needs an ontologist/owner decision rather than an inline edit.
